title: Fast one-file lint on a large index
summary: One-file lint asks the index per name for unused-public-symbol's own-unit tier, not every ref: Export.pas 20.5 -> 9.1 s on a 712k-ref index
intro: Read this when a lint of one unit feels slow on a big project index, or to see what the unused-public-symbol stage costs in a one-file lint.
